verdict.rationale: A GPU with companion software (the evidence mentions the NVIDIA app and NVIDIA Broadcast) could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The AI references (DLSS, Tensor Cores, Broadcast video enhancement, 'built-in AI processors') are rendering or compute acceleration features, not a task-delegation assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
